scope: Manually extracted event-level contract from official Reactome rendered records, checked against displayed participant lists and reaction equations. This is not an exact SBML/JSON byte export and contains no kinetic parameters or concentration data.
coefficient_status: All reaction participants below have coefficient one as written in the source reaction equations and participant lists. Exact SBML export retrieval was blocked; do not describe this file as a byte-faithful SBML conversion.

LDH.abstraction: An available active alternative supplies the modeled catalytic role; the set is not an AND requirement for all tetramers and does not establish exclusive biological alternatives.

BSG_MCT.abstraction: Aggregate available transport complex; its assembly and individual transporter kinetics are not modeled.

GAPDH.abstraction: Available active alternative; no AND requirement for both tissue-specific isoforms.

regulation_not_quantified.limit: No quantitative law or magnitude obtained. A hard inhibitor arc or zero propensity would be an added modeling assumption, not a source-derived result.

kinetic_status: UNRESOLVED: no measured rates, initial concentrations, enzyme activities, pH, thermodynamic driving forces or transport kinetics in this compact contract.
catalyst_semantics_limit: Requiring a catalyst is a guard for the selected annotated catalyzed event, not proof that no alternative or uncatalyzed physical pathway can occur.
coupling: GAPDH forward produces the same cytosolic NADH and H+ consumed by LDH forward; LDH restores the cytosolic NAD+ consumed by GAPDH. Shared entity IDs support a genuine cofactor-recycling token-network test. They do not supply clock rates or establish whole-cell dynamics.
